text:
laura: Hey team — my PR #4822 went red in CI, only one failing test in shard-3. Can I restart just that job without rebuilding the whole image? https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4822
ci-bot: Buildkite run 98765 failed (tests:shard-3). Automatic retries exhausted. See https://buildkite.com/redwood-inference/pipelines/ci/builds/98765
sam: Yep, you can usually re-run the failed job only. If it's GitHub Actions: use the 'Re-run failed jobs' from the Actions UI or gh CLI. If it's Buildkite we have a lightweight rerun flow.
raj: Quick checklist before rerunning: 1) confirm it's a test flake (look at logs) 2) ensure no infra/timeout root cause 3) if failure is during image build then you need a rebuild.
maria: For GitHub Actions (common):
```bash
# find the run id (from Actions URL) then:
gh run rerun <run-id> --failed
```
That will only re-run the failed jobs for that run.
sam: For Buildkite teams — internal helper command we use in #eng-infra (works if you have perms):
```bash
# rerun a specific job by id
bk rerun-job --build 98765 --job shard-3
# or rerun pipeline but skip image rebuild
bk rerun-build --id 98765 --skip-image-build
```
(If you don't have bk CLI, use the web UI -> job -> Retry job)
laura: I don't have bk installed. Can someone trigger from web or run the gh approach? The failing step looks like a python flaky assertion, not image build.
oncall-bot: @sam assigned — low-priority oncall task
sam: I kicked the job via the UI, retrying failed job now. Should be up in ~2m. :thumbsup:
raj: FYI if you need to do a rebuild-only (preserve test artifacts), we usually do:
```bash
# internal helper for rebuild-only
/ci rebuild --build 98765 --only-image
```
That produces a new run with same tests but fresh image; use when failure is during pip install/compile step.
maria: TL;DR: if the failing step is inside tests -> rerun failed jobs. If the failure is in setup/image -> rebuild-only. When in doubt ping @eng-infra with the run link.
laura: Thanks — checks are green after the retry. Appreciate the quick help.

sam: Nice! If it flakes again, please paste the failing test name and we can add it to flaky-test skiplist or bisect it.

laura: Will do.
